title: PIxel Painter - Decals
description: A Pixel Painter addon that allows you to place premade low res images in the world.
body:
Pixel Painter Decals is an add-on for Pixel Painter that lets you stamp custom PNG images directly into the world as Pixel Painter paint. Drop decal images into the decals folder, pick one from an in-game menu, preview it as a ghost image, then place it across blocks like a sticker.

Once stamped, decals become normal Pixel Painter paint data. They are saved, synced, and handled by Pixel Painter’s existing paint system instead of remaining separate image objects.

Features

Load PNG decals from config/pixelpainter/decals/
Select decals in-game with a Book and Quill in your offhand
Open the decal folder from the selection screen
Reload decals without restarting
Ghost preview before placement
Rotate decals in 90 degree steps
Flip decals horizontally
Stamp decals across multiple blocks
Wrap decals around corners
Supports square and rectangular decals up to 256x256 pixels
Works with Pixel Painter paint storage and networking
Multiplayer/server compatible
Experimental support for Copycat blocks, slopes, assembled contraptions, and physics bodies
How To Use

Install Pixel Painter and Pixel Painter Decals on the client and server.
Put PNG files in config/pixelpainter/decals/.
Hold a Book and Quill in your offhand.
Sneak + right-click to open the decal picker.
Select a decal, aim at a surface, rotate or mirror if needed, then right-click to stamp it.
Default Controls

Rotate left/right: < and >
Mirror horizontally: ;
Open decal picker: Sneak + right-click with Book and Quill in offhand
